literal: Love and virtue possessing if it is, domestic life, quality and fruit that.
translation: If domestic life possesses love and virtue, that is its true quality and fruit.
modern: ஒருவருடைய இல்வாழ்க்கை அன்பும் அறமும் உடையதாக இருக்குமானால், அந்த அன்பும் அறமுமே அந்த வாழ்க்கையின் நற்பண்பும் நற்பயனும் ஆகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the essence and purpose of domestic life. It states that if a household is filled with love and virtue, these two elements themselves become the defining characteristic and the ultimate reward of that life. The word 'பண்பு' (quality or nature) aligns with 'அன்பு' (love), showing the inner harmony and culture of the home. Meanwhile, 'பயன்' (fruit or result) aligns with 'அறன்' (virtue), showing the meaningful outcome of living well.
